items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I had the same boy I mentioned, Rochon, Wright.

ctx.x: None in particular, like I said, Renee, Chris, Guy Kelly, he was with Celestine Warr, and the time he'd get work, you know. Split the band, I'd work in their place. I was mostly hired out like that. And one small orchestra, with myself, let me see Rochon, where he's living, he's preaching now.

Sax. Nice sax. I was playing with Glenny, some time. I had Gus Green too, bass. I had, what's that boy, Shelly was playing with the Glen brothers? Played piano with Simon Fraser. Mm-hmm. Piano. Right, a fellow by the name of Right, tenor sax. I think it was Walter, Henry Wright, I don't know if he's working today. In the age too, I guess. How many fellows out the game, you know. Oh yeah. I didn't turn it. Instead they out. Well what about guys like Chris and Buddy and Boots and Boots and? Who's playing with the…
